title: Aggrega Catalog (MappingLibrary)
description: A reusable collection of Go template fragments that Recipes and FeatureRecipes consume at render time via `valuesMapping: { $import: ... }`. Tier 3 — opt-in for catalogs that need cross-Recipe mapping reuse. Single authoring mode: Go templates only; no parallel `mappingsJsonnet:` field.

name.description: PascalCase identifier for the library. It is the <Library> name in the bare-name identity reference <Library>#/mappings/<name>; the version is supplied by the per-Release lockfile and no registry host enters the reference or any derived identifier.

version.description: Strict Semantic Versioning of the library (e.g., 1.0.0). A consumer may assert this as an optional `:<version>` minimum-version floor in a bare-name reference (<Library>:<version>#/mappings/<name>); the per-Release lockfile owns the resolved version.

description.description: A concise summary of what the library covers.

labels.description: Author-declared labels. The compiler does not interpret label values; labels are metadata for discovery + hub UI surfacing.

annotations.description: Author-declared annotations. Same opaque-metadata posture as labels.

propertyNames.description: PascalCase identifier. Entry keys appear in canonical reference URLs (`#/mappings/<name>`); the envelope-level constraint prevents non-PascalCase keys from propagating through the catalog ecosystem.

additionalProperties.description: A single mapping entry. The value is a Go template fragment authored as a YAML string. The compiler stores the fragment verbatim at MappingLibrary load; parsing happens at Recipe / FeatureRecipe render time when the entry is imported via `valuesMapping: { $import: ... }`.

mappings.description: Named map of reusable Go template fragments. Each entry's body is opaque to the envelope validation — content semantics are handled by the Go template parser at consumption time.

spec.description: The MappingLibrary's content. spec.mappings is required and must declare at least one entry. spec carries additionalProperties: false — no parallel authoring modes (e.g., `mappingsJsonnet:`) are accepted at the envelope level. The single-authoring-mode posture keeps Recipe rendering uniform (Go template throughout) and avoids forcing authors to switch evaluation models mid-render when consuming imported fragments.
